items.title: Build a Secure, Scalable Campus Fabric with EVPN-VXLAN
items.description: FS Campus Fabric Solution helps enterprises, education institutions, and multi-site organizations build a scalable, easy-to-manage campus network. It enables secure business segmentation, simplifies operations, and supports flexible expansion for Wi-Fi 6/7 and growing access demands. With AmpCon, IT teams can centralize wired and wireless management, automate deployment and configuration, and simplify Day 0 to Day 2+ lifecycle operations.

items.title: Intelligent Solution Design
items.description: FS Design Center integrates hundreds of successful solutions into standardized templates. Quickly build robust network topologies with the confidence of battle-tested architectures.

items.title: Rapid Deployment & Proven Reliability
items.description: FS validates switch performance, reliability, and compatibility in advanced testing environments such as Ixia RFC 2544 to ensure networks integrate smoothly and roll out rapidly.

items.title: Automated Network Operations
items.description: Powered by PicOS® and AmpCon management software, FS enables intelligent network management and automated operations, ensuring long-term stability for campus network management.

items.title: Enterprise Wi-Fi 6/7 Access for Multi-Service Networks
items.description: Future-ready Wi-Fi 6/Wi-Fi 7 Infrastructure: Support high-density Wi-Fi 6/7 with higher bandwidth, lower latency, and greater capacity. Wi-Fi 7 delivers up to 9.3 Gbps with MU-MIMO, OFDMA, 320 MHz channels, and MLO for improved user experience.

items.title: Secure and Scalable EVPN-VXLAN Fabric Architecture
items.description: EVPN-VXLAN Network Virtualization: Standards-based EVPN-VXLAN architecture enables secure segmentation and flexible expansion. It supports multi-service isolation and efficient traffic forwarding, simplifying service deployment and network scaling.

items.title: Automated and Intelligent Campus Networking
items.description: Automated Deployment and Rapid Provisioning: Quickly deploy campus fabrics via AmpCon. Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP), template-based configuration, and batch deployment automate initial setups, simplify workflows, and boost IT efficiency.

items.title: Accelerating Medical Imaging Transmission with FS PicOS® Switching Solutions
items.description: FS built a scalable PicOS® network to ensure stable, low-latency video transmission and support future expansion.

items.title: Improving Government Network Reliability with FS PicOS® Redundancy Architecture
items.description: FS improved network redundancy and transmission efficiency with a resilient PicOS® architecture.

items.title: Building a 100G Wi-Fi 7 Campus Network for High-Density Biotech Operations
items.description: FS delivered an EVPN-VXLAN campus network with Wi-Fi 7 connectivity for high-speed access and simplified operations.
